newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: National airline pushes up Mauritius bourse index.
newsitem.headline: National airline pushes up Mauritius bourse index.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Mauritius market index, Semdex, resumed its upward run on Wednesday, pushed up by Air Mauritius shares, brokers said.
Semdex gained 2.77 points to 365.73 with transactions totalling 8.72 million rupees on 471,110 shares from 8.24 million rupees on 461,504 shares on Monday.
After a small drop on Monday that halted 17 sessions of gains, the Semdex resumed its upward trend propelled by Air Mauritius which surged by 2.60 rupees to 46.50 on 240 shares.
"Air Mauritius looks like being under a correction after the recent sharp downturn in its price," one broker said.
Air Mauritius fell 13 percent in the first two weeks of January after the airline reported an 86 percent slump in its pre-tax profit for the six months ending 30 September 1996.

Mauritius Commercial Bank gained 50 cents to 82.50 rupees on 16,270 shares while State Bank of Mauritius was unchanged at 11 rupees on 200,200 shares. Mauritius Breweries rose 1.0 to 131 on 485 shares and building materials manufacturer United Basalt Products climbed by 30 cents to 37.40 rupees on 1,000 shares.
Consolidated Investment Trust (CIT) fell by 50 cents to 10.30 rupees on 1,000 shares but National Investment Trust (NIT) was 20 cents up to 13.20 rupees on 38,527 shares.

In the sugar sector, Mon Tresor Mon Desert was 40 cents higher to 41.60 on 1,000 shares and Savannah (ordinary) was unchanged at 155 on 1,500 shares. Rogers lost 1.0 to 96.50 on 7,100 shares and Ireland Blyth was down 10 cents to 14.50 on 7,360 shares.

In the hotel sector, Sun Resorts gained 60 cents to 38.60 rupees on 5,180 shares but New Mauritius Hotels was stable at 32.30 rupees on 53,015 shares despite reporting a 44 percent rise in pre-tax profit for the year ending 30 September 1996.
Dealers said the results came in too late to have any bearing on New Mauritius Hotels share price during Wednesday's trading session.
